paragraphs: The M6 Gran Coupe uses the S63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, fitted throughout the F06 generation's production run from 2012 to 2018. The S63 is BMW's high-performance variant of the N63 family, sharing the same hot-vee turbo layout but with upgraded internals and higher output. The M6 Gran Coupe was BMW's four-door coupé interpretation of the M6, positioned as a more practical alternative to the two-door F13 M6 while retaining the same engine and performance hardware. The M6 range was discontinued after 2018, with the 8 Series/M8 effectively taking its place, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The M6 Gran Coupe is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the M6 Gran Coupe from 2012 to 2018 (F06). Shares the hot-vee turbo layout pattern with the wider N63/S63 family — rod bearing wear (documented but less severe than reputation suggests) and oil consumption from turbo heat soak are the main documented patterns. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every rebuild.
